# The input of scripts/skills/gen-skill-bodies.sh for the module command bodies
# skills/<module>/SKILL.md: a module's body carries, from the core, the parts
# whose entry names that module or `all`. The grounds of each entry are in the
# pull request that sets it. A line with no tab is a comment; an entry's
#   scope    a heading path: each step a heading's leading text, steps joined
#   prefix   empty: the whole heading section. Otherwise every block of the
#            scope whose first line starts with it — a paragraph, a bullet, a
#            table row, a line of a fenced block (with its indented lines)
#   modules  `all`, module names (space-separated, the generator's MODULES),
#            or `split`: the section is classified by part, and every block in
#            it needs an entry that matches it — a prefix entry matches every
#            block of its scope that starts with the prefix (`|`: every table
# The generator fails on a part of the core no entry classifies, a block two
# entries match, and an entry that matches nothing.
